fixed.summary: A figure role part inside a button (a cost inside Buy: `part="IdlePurchases.cost IdlePurchases.figure"`) takes the button's ink instead of `--figure-ink`, as its plate's other content does: the default style sets `--figure-ink: currentColor` on `button`, so a pack's figure ink stays off its plates. Before, a cost on a primary plate wore the figure ink (2.04:1 under scifi).
`color: currentcolor` (directly or through `var()`) inherits, as CSS Color 4 says: the element takes its parent's colour, and a button's content its ink. Before, it took the style's ink.

A style's rules for a document element that names a part (`[part$=".figure"]`) read the custom properties the element inherits from its document (`button { --figure-ink: … }`), as `var()` reads an element's computed values. Before, they read only the root's.
